name: helpers
eval: window.T={btn:(txt,root=document)=>[...root.querySelectorAll('button,.item,[role=menuitem]')].find(b=>(b.innerText||'').trim()===txt||b.title===txt),ask:(q)=>{const a=document.querySelector('.composer .md-field');a.value=q;a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));document.querySelector('button.send').click();},done:(n)=>{const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.message.assistant')];return m.length>=n&&!document.querySelector('.message.assistant.live')&&m[m.length-1].innerText.trim().length>0?m[m.length-1].innerText.trim():''},sleep:(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms))}; return true

name: ask
eval: T.ask('Donne un nombre entre 1 et 10.'); return true

name: copy
eval: T.btn('Copier',document.querySelector('.message.assistant')).click(); await T.sleep(500); return document.body.innerText.length>0

name: regenerate
eval: T.btn('Régénérer',document.querySelector('.message.assistant')).click(); await T.sleep(500); return true

name: one answer after regenerate
eval: return document.querySelectorAll('.message.assistant').length

name: export answer
eval: T.btn('Exporter cette réponse',document.querySelector('.message.assistant')).click(); await T.sleep(400); T.btn('Exporter en Markdown',document.querySelector('.menu')).click(); await T.sleep(800); return true

name: edit question
eval: T.btn('Modifier',document.querySelector('.message.user')).click(); await T.sleep(500); const ta=document.querySelector('.message.user .md-field'); if(!ta) return 'no editor'; ta.value='Donne un nombre entre 20 et 30.'; ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); const save=[...document.querySelectorAll('.message.user button')].find(b=>/Envoyer|Enregistrer|Valider/.test(b.innerText+b.title)); save.click(); return true

name: edited question shown
eval: return document.querySelector('.message.user').innerText.includes('20 et 30')

name: replay question
eval: T.btn('Reposer cette question à la fin de la discussion',document.querySelector('.message.user')).click(); await T.sleep(500); return true

name: two questions
eval: return document.querySelectorAll('.message.user').length

name: delete last question
eval: const us=[...document.querySelectorAll('.message.user')]; T.btn('Supprimer la question et sa réponse',us[us.length-1]).click(); await T.sleep(500); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog'); if (d) [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.classList.contains('primary')||/Supprimer/.test(b.innerText)).click(); await T.sleep(800); return document.querySelectorAll('.message.user').length

name: rename
eval: T.btn('…',document.querySelector('.topbar')).click(); await T.sleep(400); T.btn('Renommer',document.querySelector('.menu')).click(); await T.sleep(400); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog'); d.querySelector('input').value='Nombre choisi'; [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.classList.contains('primary')).click(); await T.sleep(600); return document.querySelector('.topbar').innerText.includes('Nombre choisi')

name: context preview
eval: const a=document.querySelector('.composer .md-field'); a.value='Brouillon pour essai'; a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); document.querySelector('.topbar-menu').click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('.mega [role=menuitem]')].find(e=>e.innerText.trim()==='Contexte de la prochaine question').click(); let d=null; for(let i=0;i<60;i++){ await T.sleep(250); d=document.querySelector('.dialog'); if(d && /jetons sur/.test(d.querySelector('.preview-head').innerText)) break; } const items=[...d.querySelectorAll('.preview-item')]; const ok=/jetons sur/.test(d.querySelector('.preview-head').innerText) && items[0].innerText.startsWith('Système') && items[items.length-1].innerText.includes('Brouillon pour essai'); T.btn('Fermer',d).click(); a.value=''; a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await T.sleep(300); return ok && !document.querySelector('.dialog')

name: hamburger menu
eval: const b=document.querySelector('.topbar .topbar-menu'); if(!b||document.querySelector('.topbar-api,.topbar-context,.topbar-gear')) return 'old buttons'; b.click(); await T.sleep(200); const m=document.querySelector('.menu.mega'); if(!m) return 'no panel'; const heads=[...m.querySelectorAll('h3')].map(x=>x.innerText.trim().toUpperCase()).join('|'); const items=[...m.querySelectorAll('.mega-item')].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()); const foot=m.querySelectorAll('.mega-foot .mega-short').length; document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape'})); await T.sleep(100); return heads+' '+(items.includes('Interface de programmation (API)')&&items.includes('Contexte de la prochaine question')&&items.includes('Service'))+' '+foot+' '+!document.querySelector('.menu.mega')
expect: LES RÉGLAGES|LE MAC|CETTE DISCUSSION|EN SAVOIR PLUS true 2 true

name: open menu for menu-mega.png
eval: document.querySelector('.topbar-menu').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); return !!document.querySelector('.menu.mega')

name: close menu after menu-mega.png
eval: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape'})); return !document.querySelector('.menu.mega')

name: pin
eval: T.btn('…',document.querySelector('.topbar')).click(); await T.sleep(400); T.btn('Épingler',document.querySelector('.menu')).click(); await T.sleep(600); return document.querySelector('.side-scroll').innerText.includes('ÉPINGLÉES')||document.querySelector('.side-scroll').innerText.includes('Épinglées')

name: export markdown
eval: T.btn('…',document.querySelector('.topbar')).click(); await T.sleep(400); T.btn('Exporter en Markdown',document.querySelector('.menu')).click(); await T.sleep(800); return true

name: export json
eval: T.btn('…',document.querySelector('.topbar')).click(); await T.sleep(400); T.btn('Exporter en JSON',document.querySelector('.menu')).click(); await T.sleep(800); return true

name: jump buttons
eval: return [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>/Aller au/.test(b.title)).length>0

name: stop a long answer
eval: T.ask('Écris une histoire très longue, d\'au moins deux mille mots, sur un phare.'); await T.sleep(2500); const b=document.querySelector('button.send'); const title=b.title; b.click(); await T.sleep(1500); return title

name: stopped answer kept
eval: const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.message.assistant')].pop(); return m.innerText.slice(-120)

name: delete chat
eval: T.btn('…',document.querySelector('.topbar')).click(); await T.sleep(400); T.btn('Supprimer',document.querySelector('.menu')).click(); await T.sleep(400); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog'); if (d) [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.classList.contains('primary')||/Supprimer/.test(b.innerText)).click(); await T.sleep(800); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.side-section')].pop().innerText.includes('Nombre choisi')

name: memory, name and instructions set
eval: const p=await import('/js/preferences.js'); await p.saveSetting('userName','Lucie'); await p.saveSetting('systemPrompt','Sois bref.'); await p.saveSetting('memory','La personne aime le thé.'); const s=await (await import('/js/store.js')).getSettings(); return [s.userName,s.systemPrompt,s.memory]

name: clear all resets memory, name and instructions
eval: document.querySelector('.topbar-menu').click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('.menu [role=menuitem]')].find(e=>e.innerText.trim()==='Général').click(); await T.sleep(600); [...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog .tabs button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Données').click(); await T.sleep(800); T.btn('Supprimer toutes les discussions et tous les projets').click(); await T.sleep(500); const ds=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog')]; const text=ds[ds.length-1].innerText; [...ds[ds.length-1].querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.classList.contains('primary')).click(); await T.sleep(1500); const s=await (await import('/js/store.js')).getSettings(); const {state}=await import('/js/state.js'); return [text.includes('votre nom'), s.userName||'', s.systemPrompt||'', s.memory||'', (s.memoryReset||0)>0, state.settings.userName||'', document.querySelectorAll('.dialog').length]
